dataset.description: Independent AI-authored synthetic holdout, not customer submissions

selection.protocol: G1 source-ID fit; G2 retrained from scratch using fit + disjoint feedback and weight 3 for feedback prediction errors; dev only selects threshold/generation; holdout not read
selection.gate: At least 2 fewer unflagged errors than baseline; coverage >= max(25%, baseline minus 10 percentage points).
